items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: when something happens for me that I think makes me bubble inside, I find myself talking it over with Bill.

ctx.x: So I want to go too. And it was great, to go out to the Lighthouse and a chance to hang out and be with that clown, too, which was a lot of fun. I got a bass and went out. Because it was a gig for me, he always paid. He paid so good you couldn't... He made you an offer you couldn't refuse, when you played with him.

So I went out and made this gig and it was a great... And I was saying, 'You know, Bill, I got something I want you to see.' Because all along, even until today, when something happens for me that I think makes me bubble inside, I find myself talking it over with Bill. He is one of the greatest devil's advocates you can find. And it don't take him a long time to sit and think it out. And I always respect his opinions.
He would go through the challenges with you and...
